'''Yorseg''' was a minor [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] who operated out of a [[Yorseg's base|base]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Carz]]. He double-crossed the crew of the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Smoking Blaster]]'' after first hiring them to deliver a shipment of [[Security droid/Legends|security droid]] [[Logic matrix/Legends|logic matrixes]] to [[Nilya Fek'ra]], then setting [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] on them to steal the cargo.

==Behind the scenes==
In the adventure "[[Tales of the Smoking Blaster]]," Yorseg is referred to as "Yosger" on several occasions.
